scenes.text: Something in this room is changing. You have eight seconds.
Did you catch it? The fridge. It was white.
The painting above the bed. It faded away the whole time.
Final round. Almost nobody gets this one.
The cat. He doubled in size.
And the walls? They were blue.
Two changes. At the same time.
So how many did you catch, out of four? Now watch it again.
